description: SCoT du Pays de Brest : Interfaces ville-port, ville-gare et ville-aéroport is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Brest métropole. Local urban planning documents help to highlight the city-port, city-station and city-airport interfaces identified by the SCoT, in particular in their role of image and dissemination of flows within the territory. Coverage: Brest métropole. The portal shows the English title as "SCoT of the Pays de Brest: City-port, city-station and city-airport interfaces" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Brest métropole. Its keywords include interface, urbanisme. The listing shows 4 download or service links in WFS, ARCGIS, WMS, SHP. The listing shows 2026-07-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
